statement: A freeze declared only in a remote record cannot stop a source change. Freeze declarations must be checked from trusted base/history bytes so deleting or editing the marker refuses rather than disabling the guard. Verify real PR paths: a claimed tests-only control can add and modify production source, and should then refuse under a non-test-source freeze instead of receiving a special exemption.

movesWhen.reason: Operator reviews the measurement freeze proposal, commissions its required status and resolves existing source drift.
